highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 brings the Skia m152 engine update, Graphite GPU bindings, and runtime safety fixes.
highlights_body: It adds asynchronous readback APIs, expands native package coverage, and fixes several ownership and rendering issues.

bullets.lead: Skia m152 and servicing fixes incorporated
bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer through the m152 release and subsequent upstream stability fixes.

bullets.lead: Graphite and asynchronous pixel readback APIs added
bullets.detail: Adds Graphite GPU backend bindings and backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels methods for images and surfaces.
Fixes object lifetime problems affecting stream conversion, runtime-effect uniforms, region iteration, pixmap subsets, and raster image creation.
Adds Apple symbols, restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package, and provides FreeType support for Nano Server.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Contributed platform and native-package support improvements

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the m152 release line with engine, API, and platform support updates.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 incorporated the final m152 servicing and correctness fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzzSharp shaping performance by avoiding an unnecessary feature-array copy.
